name: John Pohl
role: Owner of a strayed horse; patient at a Bismarck hospital in 1886
bio: John Pohl ran a $25 reward notice in the Cow Boy from January to May 1885 for a horse of his that had strayed or been stolen, with information to be left at the Cow Boy office. In September 1886 he strained himself and was taken to the hospital at Bismarck. By mid-October 1886 he was able to sit up but was still at the Lamborn hospital.

John Pohl strained himself in some way Saturday and was taken to the Bismarck hospital for treatment.
John Pohl has so far recovered from his strain that he is able to sit up. He is still at Lamborn hospital in Bismarck.
